title: Out of Darkness
author: Ashley Hope Perez
current_text: Canyons School District in Sandy, Utah, ordered librarians to remove Out of Darkness from library shelves pending the outcome of challenges; after an ACLU of Utah investigation, the district board decided to return the challenged books to school libraries. Out of Darkness was removed from school libraries in Lake Travis Independent School District in Austin, Texas, after some community members objected to its content, according to reports described by NCAC.

sources.quote:
11/20/21 – Canyons School District in Sandy, Utah, has ordered librarians to remove several award-winning books from library shelves pending the outcome of challenges filed against them, in direct violation of the district’s own policies.
The removed books include Toni Morrison’s The Bluest Eye, Susan Kuklin’s Beyond Magenta, Tiffany D. Jackson’s Monday’s Not Coming, Ashley Hope Perez’s Out of Darkness, and Sonya Sones’s The Opposite of Innocent.
sources.title: Utah School District Censors School Library Books | Updated - National Coalition Against Censorship

sources.quote: Updated – After an investigation by the ACLU of Utah, the Canyons School District board decided to return all nine of the challenged books to school libraries.
sources.title: Utah School District Censors School Library Books | Updated - National Coalition Against Censorship

sources.quote: NCAC has written to Lake Travis Independent School District in Austin, Texas, regarding reports that Out of Darkness by Ashley Hope Pérez was removed from school libraries after some community members objected to some of its content.
sources.title: NCAC Objects to Removal of Out of Darkness from Lake Travis, Texas, School Libraries - National Coalition Against Censorship
